name: Tsuyuri Honoka
source:
The proprietress of the hot spring inn, she exudes an air of elegance. With her gentle, unhurried demeanor, she brings a sense of calm to those around her.
A widow whose voluptuous bust is evident even beneath her kimono, she radiates an overflowing sensuality.
Her relationship with Rentarou deepens after he rescues her from a drunken patron who was pestering her.

"Welcome. We are delighted to have you at the Tsuyuri Ryokan."
